title: Rappite House, Granary Street, New Harmony, Posey County, IN
notes: Significance: This two-story, frame, gable-roofed house is characteristic of the Rappite houses in New Harmony.  Built in 1815, it was originally owned by the New Harmony Society under George Rapp.  Restored by present owner.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 66000006
